Partially linear skew-normal regression with bias reduction

snplm.Rd

Fits \(y_i = x_i^\top\beta + f(t_i) + \varepsilon_i\), \(\varepsilon_i \sim SN(0, \sigma, \alpha)\), with \(f\) a P-spline. For a fixed smoothing parameter the estimating equation is the penalized score, optionally corrected by the mean bias-reducing adjustment computed with the penalized information \(H = K + \lambda S\). The smoothing parameter is chosen on a grid by AIC with effective degrees of freedom \(\mathrm{tr}(H^{-1}K)\).

Usage

snplm(
  X,
  t,
  y,
  method = c("BR", "ML"),
  k = 12L,
  lambda = NULL,
  lambda_grid = 10^seq(-3, 4, by = 0.5)
)

Arguments

X

linear part of the model matrix (including the intercept).

t

covariate of the smooth term.

y

response.

method

`"ML"` (penalized likelihood) or `"BR"` (penalized likelihood with the mean bias-reducing adjustment).

k

basis dimension.

lambda

optional fixed smoothing parameter; if `NULL` it is selected from `lambda_grid`.

lambda_grid

grid of candidate values.

Value

A list with the coefficients, the smoothing parameter, the effective degrees of freedom, the fitted smooth, AIC and the basis.
